cards.name: Ursarctic Hextanius

effects.printed_clause: Cannot be Synchro Summoned; must be Special Summoned by sending two controlled Ursarctic monsters with Level difference 6.
effects.lua_implementation: The custom Extra Deck procedure checks face-up Ursarctic materials, exact difference, sendability and Extra Zone, then sends both.

official_references.matched_structure: Ursarctic Polari is the exact official structural family for Level-difference procedures.
official_references.official_effect_text: [b]Cannot[/b] be Synchro Summoned. Must be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending 2 monsters you control with a Level difference of 1 to the GY (1 Tuner [b]and[/b] 1 non-Tuner). If this card is Special Summoned: [b]You can[/b] activate 1 "Ursarctic Big Dipper" directly from your Deck. [b]You can[/b] Tribute 1 Level 7 or higher monster; add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 "Ursarctic" monster from your GY. [b]You can[/b] only use each effect of "Ursarctic Polari" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: For the Special Summon of any Ursarctic Synchro, this card can be Level 7 or 8 and a non-Tuner.
effects.lua_implementation: The alternate Level/non-Tuner values are consumed by the three CCG Ursarctic procedures that explicitly call Hextanius-aware helpers; the card cannot inject those choices into unrelated official Extra Deck procedures. effects.issue: Official Ursarctic Extra Deck monsters use bespoke non-Synchro EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC scripts that read card Levels directly and expose no material-side hook for Hextanius to become Level 7/8 and a non-Tuner. Only the CCG procedures that explicitly call Hextanius-aware helpers can honor the text. Resolution: update every Ursarctic summon procedure that must recognize Hextanius (including official scripts), or revise the text to limit the substitution to named CCG Ursarctic monsters.

effects.printed_clause: If Special Summoned: Special Summon a WATER monster with 700 ATK or 700 DEF from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed summon trigger filters WATER and either exact stat, checks zone, and Special Summons one.

official_references.matched_structure: Big Belly Knight demonstrates a summon trigger leading to a filtered Special Summon.
official_references.official_effect_text: If this card is detached from an Xyz Monster [b]and[/b] sent to the Graveyard to activate that monster's effect: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower monster from your hand.

effects.printed_clause: Banish this from GY; shuffle up to 3 other Ursarctic cards from GY/banishment into Deck, then draw 1.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition cost banishes self; operation selects one to three other legal cards, shuffles, then draws only if at least one returned.

official_references.matched_structure: Thunder Dragon Fusion uses shuffle-to-Deck handling across GY/banishment.
official_references.official_effect_text: Fusion Summon 1 Thunder Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, by shuffling the Fusion Materials listed on it into the Deck, from among your cards on the field, in your GY, [b]and[/b]/or your face-up banished cards. During your [b]Main Phase[/b], except the turn this card was sent to the GY: [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from your GY; add 1 Thunder monster from your Deck to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use each effect of "Thunder Dragon Fusion" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: Each listed activated effect is once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The two activated effects use id and id+100.
